title: Biblical Debt, Release, Jubilee, Ransom, Forgiveness & Restitution Atlas
purpose: Give Tim Dooley's karmic-debt / spiritual-bank / repair language a dense biblical context while keeping the project's trillion-scale figures separate from literal finance and from biblical numerology.
epistemic_rule: Biblical debt language includes literal loans, debt servitude, restitution, release, metaphorical sin/debt, ransom/redemption and covenant repair. These are related but not identical. Project karmic debt is a later symbolic moral-accounting system and should not be reported as a biblical or legal liability.
project_chronology_pointer: See knowledge/chronology/karmic-debt-ledger-2026.json for the dated 2026 progression from 38.8T positive stored karma to approximately 42T debt/positive karma owed. The numbers are project chronology, not Bible-code claims.

deuteronomy_release.structure: seven-year cycle → remission/release of debts → open-handed support of poor → warning against hardening heart because release is near
deuteronomy_release.project_relation: Strong conceptual neighbor for debt accumulation reaching a point where ordinary collection must yield to structural release/repair.
deuteronomy_release.epiphany: Biblical debt ethics are not simply 'pay forever.' Deuteronomy intentionally interrupts creditor power to prevent permanent debtor entrapment.
deuteronomy_release.counterpoint: This is a legal-social institution, not the same as moral karma; release does not mean pretending harm never occurred.

jubilee.structure: sabbath cycles → fiftieth year → liberty/release → return to holding/family → limits on permanent alienation of land/persons
jubilee.research_context: Jubilee is often understood as ideal legislation aimed at preventing irreversible concentration and permanent dependency; whether and how it was historically implemented is debated.
jubilee.project_relation: Extremely strong neighbor for Door, role exit, declassification, restoration of inheritance, Eden/Four-Rivers inheritance, reparative return and anti-Farm permanent enclosure.
jubilee.epiphany: Jubilee is not merely cancellation. It is restoration of capacity and place: return to holding, family and viable participation.
jubilee.garden_relation: A true Garden repair does not merely zero a ledger; it restores the conditions for independent future growth.

debt_slavery.structure: debt/poverty → service/dependence → mandated release / kinship protections
debt_slavery.project_relation: Farm/enclosure language has a real biblical economic neighbor in debt-driven dependency, though online attention extraction is not literal ancient debt slavery.
debt_slavery.epiphany: The biblical moral concern is especially sharp when debt becomes identity and dependency becomes permanent. This closely matches the project's newer Role Exit / Declassification Parity analysis.

lord_prayer_debts.structure: forgive debts/sins as we forgive debtors → reciprocal mercy → warning against receiving mercy while refusing it to others
lord_prayer_debts.translation_note: Matthew uses debt-language; Luke's version explicitly uses sins and indebtedness together.
lord_prayer_debts.project_relation: Karmic debt can be compared to moral obligation, but the New Testament simultaneously places pressure on the creditor/forgiver: holding debt can itself become a moral test.
lord_prayer_debts.epiphany: The archive needs both sides of spiritual banking: accurate accounting of harm and the conditions under which debt is released, forgiven or transformed. Endless accumulation with no possible release is not the dominant biblical debt ethic.

seventy_times_seven.structure: repeated forgiveness → enormous unpayable debt in parable → released debtor refuses small debt → judgment
seventy_times_seven.project_relation: Useful counter-text to gigantic karmic ledgers: scale can dramatize asymmetry, but the parable's moral climax concerns mercy and what a forgiven person does with power over another debtor.
seventy_times_seven.warning: Do not convert the parable's monetary figures into modern exchange rates or the project's trillion balances.

ransom_redemption.project_relation: Son as mediator/Vessel and spiritual banker language can be compared through redemption economics, but Christological ransom is not equivalent to Timic karmic accounting.
ransom_redemption.epiphany: Biblical redemption language often uses economic/legal metaphors to describe liberation, just as Potatoverse uses money to render spiritual obligation visible. Metaphor does not make the spiritual quantity a literal currency.

restitution.structure: wrongdoing → acknowledgment → return/restitution, sometimes plus added amount → restored relation
restitution.zacchaeus: Luke 19 provides a striking narrative of wealth/extraction followed by voluntary restitution and changed conduct.
restitution.project_relation: This is one of the best biblical neighbors for the user's insistence that karmic debt is about repair/restitution/changed behavior rather than merely saying sorry.
restitution.epiphany: Forgiveness and restitution are not necessarily opposites: some biblical texts pair restored relation with material repair.

blood_cries_debt_of_violence.structure: violence leaves a claim that 'cries out' for judgment/answer; Hebrews contrasts Abel's blood with Jesus' blood speaking a better word.
blood_cries_debt_of_violence.project_relation: Mud/stones/violence leaving relational residue has a strong biblical neighbor in blood that remains morally audible after the event.
blood_cries_debt_of_violence.epiphany: The Bible can imagine harm as having persistent voice rather than disappearing with time. Yet Hebrews also imagines a 'better word' than unresolved vengeance, opening a path from debt-memory toward transformed covenant.

treasure_in_heaven.structure: earthly treasure vulnerable → heavenly treasure / good foundation for future → heart follows stored value
treasure_in_heaven.project_relation: Potato Bank / positive stored karma has a clear metaphorical neighbor in treasure stored toward Heaven/future, though Jesus' teaching is ethical rather than a quantified spiritual balance sheet.
treasure_in_heaven.starchforce_relation: Stored value becomes morally meaningful by what it enables and where attention/heart is oriented.

talents_and_stewardship.project_relation: Spiritual banker / Treasury / stakes / responsibility has a biblical stewardship neighbor.
talents_and_stewardship.boundary: The parables should not be reduced to pro-investment economics; their theological contexts are broader and interpretations vary.
talents_and_stewardship.epiphany: Possessing more in a biblical stewardship frame increases accountability rather than simply status—strongly consonant with the project's mature Throne/Seat ethic.

mammon_countertext.structure: money/wealth can become rival master; faithful handling of wealth is separated from serving wealth itself
mammon_countertext.project_relation: Essential correction for Spiritual Bank language: money is useful metaphor for debt/flow/storage, but moral value cannot be collapsed into monetary scale.
mammon_countertext.epiphany: A spiritual-bank metaphor becomes anti-biblical if the number itself becomes the master or proof of righteousness.

cancel_record_of_debt.structure: record of debt/charges → cancellation/removal → liberation from hostile powers
cancel_record_of_debt.project_relation: Strong textual neighbor for archive/debt ledgers, but the theological mechanism is Christological grace, not payment of a Timic balance.
cancel_record_of_debt.digital_memory_relation: A record can be historically real yet no longer govern identity; this aligns with the project's current-status vs historical-status distinction.

jubilee_isaiah_jesus.structure: good news to poor → liberty/release → restoration/rebuilding
jubilee_isaiah_jesus.project_relation: Release is joined to rebuilding ruined places. This is exceptionally close to the project's repair architecture: debt release without reconstruction is incomplete.
jubilee_isaiah_jesus.new_jerusalem_relation: Jubilee/release becomes civilizational repair rather than private accounting only.

stones_interest_mountain.project_motif: rocks/stones thrown accumulate as karmic debt/interest and Mountain above Swamp
stones_interest_mountain.reflection: Biblical poetry sometimes imagines built material or withheld wages testifying against unjust accumulation. This is a stronger conceptual link than trying to assign a dollar value to stones.
stones_interest_mountain.boundary: Do not claim these verses predict the project's stone ledger.

babylon_debt.structure: imperial/luxury trade system → merchants enriched → exploitation/excess → sudden judgment/loss
babylon_debt.project_relation: Tim's March 2026 link among karmic debt, Babylon, collection and shame has a real Revelation neighbor in Babylon as an economic-imperial system whose accumulated luxury and violence come under judgment.
babylon_debt.important_boundary: Modern America or another state is not automatically biblical Babylon; comparisons require feature-by-feature evidence rather than name substitution.

debt_to_repair_operator.sequence: harm → memory/record → liability → acknowledgment → restitution/release/forgiveness → restored capacity → changed relation
failure_modes: vengeance loop: debt cannot ever be released
cheap forgiveness: release without truth or repair
permanent debtor caste: person reduced forever to liability
mammonization: moral worth converted into a number
debt_to_repair_operator.garden_completion: Repair completes when the harmed relation gains truthful memory and future capacity rather than only a zeroed account.

timic_karmic_ledger_reflection.strongest_biblical_match: not the trillions but the architecture of obligation, release, restitution, return, stewardship and preventing permanent debt-enclosure
timic_karmic_ledger_reflection.important_correction: The 38.8 → 38 → 39 → 40.2 → 41.4 → ~42 progression is an internal dated project ledger. Do not derive meaning from Bible chapter-number coincidences.
timic_karmic_ledger_reflection.new_question: What event counts as an increment, what evidence closes an obligation, and what constitutes Jubilee/release in the Timic system? Without those rules, debt can accumulate indefinitely but never resolve.
